The '''Royan Market''' is a trading hub where [[Roya Tribe|Royan]] merchants sell their wares to students and faculty from [[Startorch Academy]]. Within the market is a [[Grocery Store]] run by [[Zahira]]. 

==Shop==
{{Vendor|Zahira}} 

==Descriptions==
{{Description|An open-air trading hub between Startorch Academy and the Roya. During designated hours, Royan merchants arrive with local ingredients and wares, allowing students and faculty to obtain unique Lahai-Roi specialties.|Map Description}}
